rule: For state legislators we show votes on a fixed shortlist, chosen by a rule published before any votes were looked up: (a) the bills the three 2026 initiatives respond to: the 2025 bill that amended the parental-rights statute created by Initiative 2081 (IL26-001), the 2026 bill that created the tax on income over $1 million (IP26-645), and the 2025-26 bills on K-12 athletics eligibility (IL26-638); (b) the 2025-27 operating budget and the major revenue bills passed alongside it; (c) the 2026 supplemental operating budget. Votes shown are the final passage vote in each chamber (the last 'final passage' roll call, which is the vote on the version that became law), as recorded by the Legislature, with a link to the bill page. Bills that never received a floor vote are listed with no votes. Sponsored bills are every bill the legislator was prime sponsor of in the 2025-26 biennium.
